prompt: Stage 4-2 gold augment, level 6, 51 gold, 61 HP. You are on a 2-cost reroll: the carry is 2-star with two items and you hold 7 of her 9 copies, with two more on other boards. A loose AD component combines with nothing. The stats site's top gold augment this patch is Level Up! (8 XP now, +2 XP a round). The others are Item Anvil and Backline Tempo. Which do you take?
explanation:
The number on the site is the average placement of players who took Level Up!, almost all of them fast-8 boards at 4-2, for whom 8 XP is level 8 a round early. Your board is level 6 on purpose. At 6 a 2-cost is 40% of a slot; at 7 it is 30%. With 16 copies of your carry in a 2-cost pool of about 265, one slot shows her 2.4% of the time at 6 and 1.8% at 7. Over the 20 rolls you will make from interest this stage, that is 2.4 expected copies against 1.8, and you need exactly 2. The top-rated augment moves you from hitting the 3-star to probably not.

Item Anvil is power this round and every round after: a third completed item on the carry, chosen from four, and no more hoping the 4-7 drop pairs the dead component. Backline Tempo is the acceptable second; 20% attack speed on a real carry is fine, but a completed item is more.

Framework, question two: does it fit the econ plan you chose at 3-2? Level Up! fails it.
principle: An augment that is best on average is best for the plan the average player was on; check it against yours before the tier list.
commonMistake: Taking the top-rated XP augment on a reroll board and levelling away the odds for the last two copies.
hint: Ask what each augment does to the odds of the two copies you still need, at the level you have chosen to sit at.
